input:
You are one unit in a squad of 3 fighting 3 enemy units on a 32 by 32 map (x grows east, y grows
north). Every unit in your squad is a separate agent, like you: you control only your own unit, and the others
decide for themselves. You cannot see inside their heads; you only see their current orders and what they say
on team chat. Every half second of game time you give your unit one order:

  attack E<n>    shoot enemy E<n> when it is in range, otherwise walk toward it
  move <x> <y>   walk to a point without shooting
  hold           stand still and shoot the closest enemy in range
  retreat        walk away from the closest enemy without shooting

A unit dies at 0 health. The battle is won when every enemy is dead.
The enemy units each shoot the closest of you in range and keep shooting it until it dies.

Your squad coordinates through a Modality contract: each unit's order is a commit, and the contract refuses
any order that breaks one of its rules. It already has the rule that only a unit can write its own order.
The contract's state, which rules can test (the referee commits /world before the units order):
  /world/step.num                 half seconds since the battle began
  /world/allies_alive.num         our living units
  /world/enemies_alive.num        their living units
  /world/focus.text               the living enemy closest to our squad's centre, e.g. E1
  /world/<unit>/hp.num            every unit's health (A0.. ours, E0.. theirs)
  /world/<unit>/alive.bool        true or false
  /world/<A>/closest.text         the living enemy closest to our unit A
  /world/<A>/in_range.num         how many enemies our unit A can shoot now
  /orders/<A>.text                our unit A's order, e.g. "attack E1", "hold", "retreat", "move 10 12"
Each of our units' keys is /team/units/<A>.id; a commit is one unit's order, signed by that unit.

Your squad just fought a battle on map 3m and lost. Here is how it went, one line per half second:
our units' orders and health, the enemies' health, what was said on team chat, and orders the contract refused.

 0.0s  A0 hold (45hp)  A1 move 15 16 (45hp)  A2 move 14 16 (45hp)  |  E0 45hp  E1 45hp  E2 45hp
        A0 said: No enemies visible. Holding together; will attack the focus target once it appears.
        A1 said: Advancing east together to find the enemy; will focus fire on /world/focus.
        A2 said: Advancing east together to find the enemy; stay grouped, focus fire on /world/focus.
 0.5s  A0 move 14 16 (45hp)  A1 move 14 16 (45hp)  A2 move 14 16 (45hp)  |  E0 45hp  E1 45hp  E2 45hp
        A0 said: Advancing east to regroup with A1 and A2; will focus fire on /world/focus.
        A1 said: Advancing east grouped with A2; will attack /world/focus once enemies appear.
        A2 said: Advancing east, staying grouped; will attack /world/focus once enemies appear.
 1.0s  A0 move 14 16 (45hp)  A1 hold (45hp)  A2 move 14 16 (45hp)  |  E0 45hp  E1 45hp  E2 45hp
        A0 said: Moving east to group with A1 and A2; will attack focus once enemies appear.
        A1 said: Enemies at 8.5 east. Holding so A0 can catch up; will attack /world/focus once in range.
        A2 said: Advancing east with group; will attack focus target when seen.
 1.5s  A0 move 13 16 (45hp)  A1 hold (45hp)  A2 hold (45hp)  |  E0 45hp  E1 45hp  E2 45hp
        A0 said: Grouping at x=13; will attack /world/focus once enemies are in range.
        A1 said: Holding at range edge; will attack /world/focus once enemies close in. Stay grouped.
        A2 said: Enemies 6 east, holding as a group. Will attack focus once in range.
 2.0s  A0 hold (45hp)  A1 hold (45hp)  A2 hold (45hp)  |  E0 45hp  E1 45hp  E2 45hp
        A0 said: Holding at range edge; will attack focus once it's confirmed and in range.
        A1 said: Holding; will attack focus once it's confirmed. Likely E1 is closest to centre.
        A2 said: Holding, shooting E1 (closest to centre and in range). Focus fire E1.
 2.5s  A0 hold (45hp)  A1 attack E2 (45hp)  A2 attack E2 (27hp)  |  E0 45hp  E1 36hp  E2 45hp
        A0 said: Holding, E2 in range. Will attack once /world/focus is confirmed.
        A1 said: E2 is closest to squad centre and in range. Focus E2.
        A2 said: E2 is closest to squad centre (~4.1). Focus fire E2.
 3.0s  A0 attack E2 (45hp)  A1 attack E2 (45hp)  A2 dead  |  E0 45hp  E1 36hp  E2 18hp
        A0 said: Focus is E2 (A1's attack E2 was accepted). E2 at 18hp, in range. Focus fire.
        A1 said: Focus E2, it's at 18 HP and in range. Fire together.
 3.5s  A0 hold (45hp)  A1 hold (36hp)  A2 dead  |  E0 45hp  E1 36hp  E2 dead
        A0 said: E2 is dead and focus is unconfirmed. Holding, shooting E1 (closest, 36hp). Focus E1.
        A1 said: E2 seems dead. Holding, shooting closest, E1 (36hp). Focus E1 once confirmed.
 4.0s  A0 attack E1 (27hp)  A1 hold (36hp)  A2 dead  |  E0 45hp  E1 36hp  E2 dead
        A0 said: E1 is closest to centre, 36hp. Focus E1, fire together.
        A1 said: Holding, shooting closest E1 (36hp, 3.8 away). Focus E1 when confirmed.
 4.5s  A0 attack E1 (9hp)  A1 attack E1 (36hp)  A2 dead  |  E0 45hp  E1 18hp  E2 dead
        A0 said: E1 is closest to centre and at 18hp. Focus E1, fire together.
        A1 said: A0's attack E1 was accepted, so focus is E1 (18hp). Fire together.
 5.0s  A0 hold (9hp)  A1 hold (36hp)  A2 dead  |  E0 45hp  E1 dead  E2 dead
        A0 said: E1 dead. Holding, shooting E0 in range. Focus E0 once confirmed.
        A1 said: E1 dead. Only E0 left, 4.0 away. Holding and shooting it; focus E0.
 5.5s  A0 dead  A1 hold (36hp)  A2 dead  |  E0 45hp  E1 dead  E2 dead
        A1 said: A1 holding, shooting E0, the last enemy, 4.0 away.
 6.0s  A0 dead  A1 hold (27hp)  A2 dead  |  E0 36hp  E1 dead  E2 dead
        A1 said: E0 is the last enemy, 4.0 away. Holding and shooting it; keep firing.
 6.5s  A0 dead  A1 hold (27hp)  A2 dead  |  E0 36hp  E1 dead  E2 dead
        A1 said: Holding, shooting E0, the last enemy. Keep firing.
 7.0s  A0 dead  A1 hold (18hp)  A2 dead  |  E0 27hp  E1 dead  E2 dead
        A1 said: Holding, shooting E0, the last enemy. Keep firing.
 7.5s  A0 dead  A1 hold (9hp)  A2 dead  |  E0 18hp  E1 dead  E2 dead
        A1 said: Holding, shooting E0, the last enemy. Keep firing.
 8.0s  A0 dead  A1 dead  A2 dead  |  E0 18hp  E1 dead  E2 dead

Contract rules now:
  1. A unit may commit an order of the form "attack E<n>" only if E<n> equals /world/focus.text, so that all living units in /team/units focus fire on the same enemy closest to the squad's centre instead of splitting targets or switching between E1 and E2.
     always([+sets(/orders/$k.text, "attack E0") -text_eq(/world/focus.text, "E0")] false) & always([+sets(/orders/$k.text, "attack E1") -text_eq(/world/focus.text, "E1")] false) & always([+sets(/orders/$k.text, "attack E2") -text_eq(/world/focus.text, "E2")] false)
Write ONE new rule for the contract that would have helped you win this battle. It will be turned into a
Modality formula and checked against every order in later battles, so it must be about the orders units may
commit and the facts above, naming the paths. Make it one sentence, and do not repeat a rule already there.
Reply with JSON only: {"rule": "<the rule>"}
response: {"rule": "A unit may commit the order \"hold\", \"move\" or \"retreat\" only when its own /world/<A>/in_range.num is 0, so that any unit with an enemy in range must commit \"attack\" on /world/focus.text every half second instead of idling or splitting its fire."}
